_note: What lands on the grid and fills customer dishes. Ids mirror the raw ingredient ids for this map 1:1, which is why the dish strings in levels.json use the same numbers. fileId values come from MapDefinitions.csv's recipe_piece table, which (as of the 2026-08 reimport) has its own distinct cooked-art file ids, separate from the matching raw ingredient's — previously this table had no separate cooked artwork and these fell back to the raw thumbnails. baseId: another cooked ingredient id (or any one of several, e.g. a sauce shared across several fried bases) that must already be in the dish before this one can be served to it (toppings need the bun there first; ice needs the cup there first). usageNum > 1: this ingredient can be served that many times before it's used up (e.g. a shared sauce) — see Simulation.consumeCookedCell. limit: max copies of this ingredient one dish's order can call for; absent/0 = no limit, enforced by the Design mode dish editor (bun/cup/ice/base items only ever appear once per dish). Ids 9-16 are numbered to match MapDefinitions.csv's Map1_burger recipe_piece table exactly (the CSV inserts chick_breast_fried at 9, shifting wing/thigh/nugget/potato/chili_bowl down; chive=15/cheese_sauce=16, confirmed by the raw ingredient_process table's OutIndex in the 2026-08 reimport, which no longer contradicts recipe_piece — see ingredients.json's note).
